messages.text: Please make sure we are reminding every single entertainer when they check in with you: #1. Starting Monday ALL House fee MUST be paid upfront or they will not be able to work that shift. #2. Ask them if they have hit the QR code for the Spotify Playlist, if not, try to have them do it right there. Please make sure you are reminding EVERY GIRL you see on your shifts of these two things. I really don't want to have to send anyone home. Thank you
Good evening everyone!! Hope you have an amazing shift or time off... either way, enjoy!!!
I've been letting dancers know about the upfront house fees and I've just been getting weird looks as if I made those rules.
